s.t:
Work @ everii
Du willst mit deinem Code echten Mehrwert schaffen und an einer smarten All-in-one ERP-Software für Agenturen, Beratungen und IT-Dienstleister mitbauen? Du liebst sauberen Code, pragmatische Lösungen und hast Freude daran, echten Produkt-Impact zu schaffen?Dann bist du bei everii genau richtig!Baue mit uns Teambox weiter aus – und gestalte die Arbeitswelt von morgen.

Als Senior Software Engineer / Developer arbeitest du an unserem Produkt Teambox – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Design, Product und Operations.
Dein Fokus liegt darauf, Features ganzheitlich zu denken, zu implementieren, zu testen und auszurollen – stets mit Blick auf Usability, Performance und Stabilität. Dabei hast du viel Freiraum, eigene Schwerpunkte zu setzen und neue Ansätze auszuprobieren.
Aufgaben
Qualität & Testing: Automatisierte Tests, Code Reviews und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Code-Qualität & DX.
APIs & Integrationen: Weiterentwicklung unserer APIs (REST/GraphQL) und Anbindung externer Services.
Betrieb & Monitoring: Verantwortung für stabile, sichere Releases; Troubleshooting entlang unserer CI/CD-Pipelines.
Collaboration: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Design & Product – kurze Feedback-Loops, daten- und nutzerzentrierte Entscheidungen.
Qualifikation
SaaS-Erfahrung: Idealerweise hast du bereits an einem SaaS-Produkt gearbeitet, das am Markt etabliert ist.
AI-Knowhow: Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung darin, KI von Anfang an gezielt als Treiber im Entwicklungsprozess einzusetzen.
Stack-Fit: Solide Programmiererfahrung in gängigen Sprachen – idealerweise PHP und JavaScript/TypeScript (z. B. React/Vue).
Qualität & Pragmatismus: Dein Code ist wartbar und durchdacht – ohne „Gebastel“, aber mit Sinn für gesunden Pragmatismus.
Testing & CI/CD: Routine mit automatisiertem Testing sowie Continuous Integration/Delivery.
API-Kompetenz: Erfahrung mit REST- und GraphQL-APIs.
System-Basics: Grundkenntnisse im Umgang mit Linux-Servern und containerbasierten Setups.
Neugier & Lernfreude: Du entwickelst dich gerne weiter und probierst neue Technologien reflektiert aus.
Begeisterungsfähigkeit: Freude am Ergebnis und positives Nutzerfeedback sind deine Motivation.
Kommunikation & Teamspirit: Du vertrittst deine Meinung klar, diskutierst konstruktiv und trägst Entscheidungen gemeinsam mit.
Sprachen: Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Individuelle Entwicklung: Raum für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, Gestaltungsspielraum und kontinuierliches Lernen.
Smart Work: Moderne technische Ausstattung, flexibles und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, hybrides Arbeitsmodell und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
Feel-Good-Atmosphäre: Frisches Obst, Kaffee, gekühlte Getränke und wöchentliches gemeinsames Frühstück/Jause im Office – im Herzen von Hamburg, Frankfurt oder Wien.
Tech-Stack & Team: Moderne Tools und Technologien in einem produktnahen Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
Stabilität: Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit, Start ab sofort möglich.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatum.

“Any fool can write code that a computer can understand. Good programmers write code that humans can understand.” – Martin Fowler
Unser Erfolg? Teamsache!
Wir sind isento (portugiesisch: „frei“) und realisieren IT-Projekte in Nürnberg von der Konzeption bis zum Rollout. Für eines unserer Teams suchen wir aktuell Unterstützung. Als Software Developer bringst Du Dich dort bei der Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen für die Herausforderungen unseres Kundens ein. Wir isentos verstehen uns als Team.

Uns ist es wichtig, dass wir uns jederzeit aufeinander verlassen können - fachlich genauso wie persönlich. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig und helfen einander, denn nur so erreichen wir unser gemeinsames Ziel: die beste Lösung für unsere Kunden abzuliefern.
Aufgaben
Dein Job bei isento
Mit deinem crossfunktionalen Team entwickelst du eine Cloudanwendung zur Digitalisierung zentraler Geschäftsprozesse im Bereich Billing & Invoicing.
Dabei tragt ihr die Verantwortung für den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Software von der Konzeption über Entwicklung und Tests bis hin zu Deployment und Monitoring.
Verständlicher Code, Unit- und Integrationstests, Code Reviews, Wissensaustausch und Pair Programming gehören dabei genauso zu Deinem Alltag wie die Konzeption neuer Features und die Abstimmung mit Stakeholdern
In Deinem Projektalltag arbeitest Du mit Technologien wie Angular, Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, PostgreSQL, Object Stores, GitHub Actions und Cloudtechnologien
Dabei bringst Du Dich aktiv ein, entwickelst eigene Ideen und treibst Themen mit Verantwortung und Weitblick voran
Qualifikation
Das bringst Du mit
Du beherrschst Angular und Spring Boot sicher
Softwareentwicklung ist Deine Leidenschaft
Du hast mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in Softwareprojekten gesammelt und weißt, worauf es bei skalierbaren, wartbaren Lösungen ankommt
Hilfreich sind Kenntnisse in Spring Boot, GitHub Actions, Apache Kafka, Barrierefreiheit und Cloudtechnologien. Entscheidend ist Deine Bereitschaft, Dich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten
Du bist neugierig, suchst den Austausch und teilst Dein Wissen, um gemeinsam voneinander zu lernen und zu wachsen
Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B2) ermöglichen Dir eine souveräne Kommunikation im Team und mit Stakeholdern.

Das bieten wir dir
Zuschüsse: wir unterstützen Dich finanziell beim JobRad-Leasing, beim ÖPNV und bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
Momente für die Ewigkeit: gemeinsam mit Dir feiern wir Grillparties, verbringen Spieleabende zusammen, tauschen uns bei Duke Days aus und stoßen beim Sommerfest gemeinsam an
Wachstum: bring Dich ein und wachse - mit uns als Unternehmen, im Team und ganz persönlich durch individuelle Weiterbildung und Trainings, die zu Dir passen
Freiraum: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten sorgen für die richtige Mischung aus Work und Life.
Spannung: freu‘ Dich auch auf weitere spannende Projekte bei unseren Kunden und auf unsere hauseigenen Projekte im Bereich Robotik, KI und Machine Learning
Ausgezeichnete Unternehmenskultur: wir sind seit fünf Jahren in Folge ausgezeichnet als Top Arbeitgeber und legen großen Wert auf eine freundliche und von Respekt geprägte Arbeitsatmosphäre

ORDERYOYO Lead Software Engineer – Payments Remote · Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices · Competitive salary About the Role At OrderYOYO , payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.

We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer – Payments to own the next stage of our payments platform's evolution — as a hands-on technical leader who can grow and manage a team of payments engineers, set the technical direction for a business-critical domain, and support our transition to a more scalable operating model across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).

You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money — from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing — while building and developing the people who make that possible.

Role Mission Lead the people, architecture, and delivery behind OrderYOYO 's payments platform — enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing — while growing a high-performing engineering team and raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.

Core Responsibilities People Leadership & Team Development Lead, mentor, and grow a team of payments engineers — providing hands-on technical guidance, regular feedback, and clear paths for career development.
Own hiring and team-building for the payments engineering function, partnering with recruiting to define role profiles, run interviews, and bring in strong talent.
Run day-to-day people management: 1:1s, goal-setting, performance reviews, and career progression conversations for direct reports.
Build a team culture where payments knowledge is documented and shared, not tribal — through design reviews, standards, and mentoring.
Represent the payments engineering team in leadership and cross-functional conversations, translating business needs into technical strategy and team priorities.
Balance hands-on technical contribution with people-management responsibilities, staying close enough to the codebase to lead by example and unblock the team.
Technical & Domain Ownership Set the technical direction and long-term architecture strategy for payment-domain services, including gateway integrations, payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.
Oversee marketplace capabilities: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.
Ensure robust “flow-of-funds” primitives across the team's systems — idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.
Own the strategy for PSP and partner integrations, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.
Oversee dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and drive collaboration with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.
Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.
Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain: automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements, with accountability for outcomes across the team.
Must-Have Requirements Proven experience leading, mentoring, or people-managing a team of software engineers — including hiring, performance management, and career development.
Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems — microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.
Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-entry thinking, and auditability.
A solid security mindset: PCI compliance, PII protection, secrets management, least privilege, and secure coding practices.
Comfort working in an Azure-first environment (APIs, queues/eventing, monitoring), with strong CI/CD and automated testing practices.
Clear, confident communication with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders in high-stakes scenarios — incidents, financial breaks, and compliance requests.
Strong judgement on when to move fast, when to standardise, and when to say “not yet” with evidence — balancing team capacity, technical debt, and business priorities.
Strong-to-Have Experience Experience scaling or restructuring an engineering team through periods of growth or organisational change.
Experience with sub-merchant, marketplace, or Payfac-like operating models (KYC, underwriting, settlements, fee deductions).
Familiarity with dispute tooling, card scheme rules, 3DS/risk rules, or fraud platforms.
Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, or Finance leadership on regulatory or audit requirements.
Who We Are At OrderYOYO , company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build.

Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve. We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business.

By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably. Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe. What We Offer
· Competitive salary. A remote role — work from wherever you do your best work, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.
High ownership and autonomy, with a direct hand in shaping the team you lead.
A clear leadership mandate, with scope to grow further into broader engineering management responsibilities.
The opportunity to lead work on revenue-critical production systems.
A strong focus on security, reliability, and engineering best practices.
A collaborative, international engineering team.
Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and long-term growth — for you and for the people you lead.

Als Platform Architect / Staff Engineer bist du Eigentümer der Core Platform Architecture – und du baust sie selbst, hands-on. Du denkst in Self-Service-Capabilities, sauberen Contracts und klaren Boundaries – und du machst das Platform-Team zum Agentic-Engineering-Lighthouse der gesamten Organisation. Hands-on bauen. Du leitest und trägst persönlich zum Proof-of-Concept bei, der die kritischen Hypothesen validiert – und danach zu den Platform Services selbst. Du bist Builder, nicht nur Designer.
Platform as a Product. Du designst Services als Self-Service-Capabilities, die Module-Teams unblocked halten. Thinnest viable Platform beats Gold-Plating, immer.
Contracts & Standards setzen und schützen. Du definierst und sicherst die Contracts zwischen Plattform und Module-Teams: APIs, Boundaries, Non-Functional Requirements – und sorgst dafür, dass sie eingehalten werden.
Agentic-First von Tag eins. Du etablierst disziplinierte Agentic-Engineering-Practices im Platform-Team und machst es zur Referenz für die gesamte Engineering-Organisation.

Hands-on Builder mit starkem Track Record. Du hast Plattformen oder Services at scale architektiert und gebaut – und du codest noch. Kein reiner Architecture-by-PowerPoint-Hintergrund.
Platform-as-a-Product-Instinct. Du hast Self-Service-Plattformen gebaut, die andere Teams schneller gemacht haben. Du weißt, wie Plattformen zum Bottleneck werden – und designst aktiv dagegen. Interne Teams sind für dich echte Kunden.
Sound Engineering Practices. Testing, Contracts, Observability, CI/CD, klare Boundaries – und das Urteilsvermögen, welche Non-Functional Requirements tatsächlich zählen.
Genuine Motivation für Agentic Engineering. Du willst Agentic-First mit Disziplin bauen, nicht mit Hype – und du willst es für andere modellieren.

At Jumio , the Software Development Engineer IV - QA (SDE-IV, QA) is a senior technical role focused on ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of highly scalable web portals and distributed backend systems. Our platform spans multiple Java Spring Boot microservices and customer-facing web portals , deployed across AWS ECS, EKS, and Lambda , and integrated through event-driven messaging using SNS/SQS .
In this role you will design and drive the test automation strategy for both UI (Playwright) and API/service layers, set the quality bar for the team, and act as a force multiplier — mentoring other engineers and embedding quality earlier in the development lifecycle. You will work closely with development, product, and DevOps teams to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality, scalability, and security.
This is a hands-on senior IC role: you will write code, but you will also influence architecture, own cross-service test strategy, and make build-vs-buy decisions for testing tooling.
T-Shaped Engineering Expectation
As part of Jumio 's engineering culture, you will adopt a T-shaped engineering approach. Beyond deep expertise in test automation and quality engineering, you will contribute across the development lifecycle — understanding software architecture, participating in design and API-contract discussions, reviewing application code, and ensuring our distributed systems are testable, observable, and resilient by design.
Role Value
This role is critical to ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of Jumio 's products. By architecting and maintaining automated testing frameworks across web, API, and event-driven layers, you will enable faster, higher-confidence releases and reduce production risk in a complex microservices environment.

Test Architecture & Strategy
Define and own the end-to-end automated test strategy across web portals and backend microservices, balancing UI, API, contract, integration, and end-to-end coverage (test pyramid).
Design test strategies for distributed, event-driven systems — including asynchronous flows through SNS/SQS , eventual consistency, idempotency, message ordering, retries, and dead-letter handling.
Automation Engineering
Develop and maintain robust test automation frameworks for web ( Playwright , Selenium, or equivalent) and API testing, using Java and/or JavaScript/TypeScript .
Automate API and service-level testing (REST/JSON, and async messaging) to validate functionality, performance, and resilience.
Build maintainable, scalable framework abstractions (page objects, fixtures, data builders, reusable test harnesses) that other engineers adopt.
Cloud-Native & Non-Functional Testing
Design tests that run against services deployed on ECS, EKS, and Lambda , including environment provisioning and teardown.
Use tools like TestContainers / LocalStack to test AWS integrations (SQS/SNS, Lambda, etc.) reliably and locally.
Drive performance, load, and resilience testing (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust) for highly scalable services, and partner with engineering on results and bottlenecks.
Contribute to non-functional quality: basic security testing, reliability, and chaos/failure-injection where appropriate.
CI/CD & Quality Engineering
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions / Jenkins / GitLab CI) to enable fast feedback and continuous delivery.
Improve test reliability — reduce flakiness, optimize execution time, enable parallelization, and improve observability of test results.
Define and track quality metrics (coverage, escape rate, MTTR, flake rate) and use them to drive decisions.
AI-Augmented Engineering

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings.

Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods.

GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.

You will be part of a highly collaborative product team working at the core of our manufacturing facility, transforming digital models into physical elements at scale.
Product Teams at GROPYUS own what they build, including underlying infrastructure, build pipelines, automated testing, release and rollout management, monitoring, and support. You will bring your experience in working with PLCs and/or other OT systems like e.g. robots, into the team.
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help evolve manufacturing systems from vendor-driven PLC and robot logic toward a modern, software-defined architecture. A central part of the role is to understand existing control logic, abstract it into maintainable software components, and gradually migrate relevant functionality into Python- based services and simulation-ready systems.
Furthermore, our teams are also responsible for operating and troubleshooting the software they have developed during working hours of the factory.

As a Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d) on the Product Delivery team, you will be responsible for:
Analyze and explain existing PLC (Siemens TIA Portal), robot (KUKA KRL), and OT code from external vendors, and help translate that knowledge into shared engineering understanding
Design and implement Python-based software components that replace, abstract, or orchestrate legacy PLC and robot logic
Build maintainable, testable, and well-structured services with a strong focus on code quality, modularity, and long-term ownership
Bringing an operational mindset to monitor, maintain, and improve software uptime including reliable updates, latency, and efficiency
Acting as a bridge between digital product delivery & physical logistics and manufacturing systems, ensuring both are aligned and integrated
Helping define, monitor and evolve SLAs/SLOs as well as other important KPIs like e.g. OEE for critical systems

You are an experienced software engineer with very good coding skills in Python or another modern object-oriented programming language such as C++ or C#.
You have a solid understanding of software design, abstraction, modularity, and maintainable system architecture.
You have experience writing clean, testable, production-grade code and applying modern software engineering practices such as code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD.
You are confident working in operationally critical environments where reliability, observability, and controlled change management matter.
You have the ability to understand and gradually modernize legacy systems without losing business continuity.
You are able to communicate effectively across software, manufacturing, and operations domains.

You have experience with PLC programming, industrial robots, or OT systems.
You are familiar with KUKA KRL, OPC-UA, MQTT, or similar industrial integration technologies.
You have worked in logistics, manufacturing, or other production-critical environments.
You are familiar with simulation-driven development or digital twins.

An unlimited contract with 30 vacation days.
Flexible, hybrid work: You can work from home or come into the office on the schedule that works best for you. Feel like traveling and working from another location? No problem. Tune into meetings and work from abroad for up to 40 days per year. In addition, flex hours allow you to prioritize important moments in your day.

Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.
We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.
We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.
Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.
We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

You'll work across LabOS — our internal software platform — building the orchestration layer that coordinates everything from experiment scheduling to execution to data capture and results processing. This is full-stack product engineering at the intersection of software and physical-world biology.

s.h: Day-to-day, that can mean things like
s.t:
Creating interfaces and APIs that give scientists and AI agents visibility into what's happening in the lab in real time
Building custom AI agents and tooling that automate decisions across the experiment lifecycle, from protocol design to troubleshooting failed results
Turning proprietary hardware into API-controllable devices that agents and software can operate programmatically
Designing scheduling systems that coordinate dozens of lab instruments with complex dependency chains
You'll own large areas of the product. We're a small team where individual engineers have large impact on what gets built and how.

Full-stack production experience. We use TypeScript, React, Node, Postgres, but what matters is you can work across the stack.
Product instinct. You've shipped, watched users, iterated, and shipped again.
Comfortable in ambiguity. You start from a goal, not a spec. You scope problems down, decide what to build and what to skip, and write your own plan when none exists.
Builds with AI. You use AI tools heavily, but you have enough experience without them to know what good looks like.
Curious about biology. No background required, but running real experiments in the physical world should excite you.
Application deadline
We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

Zur Fertigstellung unseres Produktes, suchen wir einen Entwickler/Developer ein auf 2 Monate befristetes Projekt. Übernahme für weitere Projekte möglich.
Dein gemeldeter Wohnsitz ist in Deutschland. Du arbeitest auch in Deutschland.
Dein Anschreiben wünschen wir uns in deutscher Sprache.
Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend.
Aufgaben
React & TypeScript – Grundsolide
Du musst keine Senior-Expertise mitbringen, aber du musst React wirklich verstanden haben: Komponenten, Props, State, Hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext), einfache Custom Hooks. TypeScript sollte dir nicht fremd sein – du musst keine komplexen Generics schreiben, aber du musst Typen definieren und Fehler im Compiler lesen können.
Supabase – Bereitschaft zur schnellen Einarbeitung
Du solltest wissen, was eine relationale Datenbank ist, SQL-Grundabfragen schreiben können (SELECT, INSERT, JOIN) und das Konzept von Authentifizierung und Autorisierung verstehen. Supabase selbst kannst du on the job lernen – aber der Wille, dich in Row Level Security, Supabase Auth und Echtzeit-Subscriptions einzuarbeiten, muss vorhanden sein. Wenn du schon mal mit Supabase, Firebase oder PocketBase gearbeitet hast: großer Vorteil.
Grundlegendes Verständnis von Web-Entwicklung
HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, Formulare, Routing – das muss sitzen. Du weißt, was ein API-Aufruf ist und wie man mit fetch oder axios Daten holt.
Umgang mit KI-Tools als Entwicklungsassistent
Das ist uns besonders wichtig: Wir entwickeln mit Lovable (KI-gestütztes Frontend-Building) und Claude Code (KI-Pair-Programmer im Terminal). Du musst keine Erfahrung damit mitbringen, aber du musst neugierig und offen dafür sein. Wer KI-Tools als Bedrohung sieht, passt hier nicht rein. Wer sie als Turbo für die eigene Produktivität begreift: herzlich willkommen.
Git & grundlegender Deployment-Workflow
Commits, Branches, Pull Requests – das muss funktionieren. Du solltest wissen, wie man eine App auf Vercel deployt oder zumindest bereit sein, das in Stunde 1 zu lernen.
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten
Wir haben keine Zeit für Mikromanagement. Du bekommst ein Gewerk, ein Ziel und wöchentliche Check-ins. Dazwischen arbeitest du selbstständig, dokumentierst sauber und fragst, wenn du wirklich feststeckst – aber nicht nach jedem kleinen Problem.
Usability, UI & UX – Empathisches Produktgefühl
Du entwickelst nicht nur Features, die technisch funktionieren, sondern Oberflächen, die Menschen gerne benutzen. Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann ein Formular zu kompliziert ist, ein Button nicht eindeutig genug wirkt oder ein Flow unnötig Reibung erzeugt.

Pixel-Perfektion ist nicht das Ziel – aber Empathie für Nutzer:innen, saubere Interfaces, klare Zustände, verständliche Fehlermeldungen und ein Blick für einfache, intuitive Bedienung sind uns extrem wichtig. Du denkst beim Entwickeln mit: „Versteht das jemand sofort?“ – und nicht nur: „Läuft der Code?“

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication . We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.
You will join DeepL Voice , the team defining the art of the possible for real-time interpretation. While our Translation engine conquered text, Voice is conquering the physical world. We are building the "Universal Translator"; enabling fluid, real-time conversations for frontline workers, global meetings, and enterprise teams.
This is a 0-to-1 engineering environment. We successfully launched our first customer-facing features in late 2024, but we are just getting started. We are tackling the hardest problems in AI interaction: How do you eliminate the "flickering" effect of unstable transcripts? How do you chain chunked inference to achieve sub-millisecond latency? How do you deliver a seamless audio stream that feels natural, not robotic?.
You will work in a dynamic, cross-functional squad alongside Researchers, Product Managers, and Designers. We are not just wrapping an API; we are building the proprietary models, the streaming architecture, and the user interfaces that allow the world to speak without barriers.

A "0-to-1" Builder Mindset: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't need a roadmap to build; you need a problem. You are comfortable prototyping a new feature in the morning and refactoring it for scale in the afternoon.
Product Obsession: You care about the flow of the conversation. You understand that "99% accuracy" means nothing if the audio arrives 3 seconds late. You optimize for the human experience.
Ship End-to-End Features: Build and deploy impactful features across the entire stack, from high-performance frontend UIs to streaming audio services on the backend and AI inference integration.
Tackle Real-Time Complexity: Debug and resolve challenging edge cases unique to real-time communication, including sub-second latency spikes, transcript flicker, audio glitches, and unstable network environments.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely in a tight-knit, cross-functional squad alongside PMs, Product Designers, and AI Researchers to scope, shape, and solve hard product and technical challenges.
Qualities we look for
A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.
Full-Stack Fluency: You're comfortable across the stack — building polished, modern UI in React and TypeScript on the frontend, and shipping backend services in Node.js/TypeScript (or a strongly transferable language, with willingness to ramp) on the backend.
Real-time: WebRTC, WebSockets, streaming architectures, latency-sensitive systems.
High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.
A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company , not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline . If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

s.h: Este rol NO es para ti si
s.t:
Prefieres que te lleguen las tareas ya definidas. Se te va a decir qué hay que lograr, no cómo. Escalas lo que no esté a tu alcance; el resto lo resuelves.
No estás dispuesto a salir de tu lenguaje. No pedimos que llegues sabiendo las tres tecnologías: sí que ninguna te frene.
Buscas un entorno protocolar y ordenado. Somos un scale up con cultura de startup: se avanza rápido, se acepta deuda y hay que ser capaz de crear orden dentro de la fluidez.

+5 años desarrollando software y experiencia real como fullstack.
.NET/C# sólido. Es el backend del producto y ahí esperamos fuerza real. Python, que usan los servicios que consumes, se aprende acá.
React de cara al cliente. No necesitas ser el referente de front, pero sí construir features completas y sostener las convenciones del squad.
Clean Architecture aplicada, no leída. Inversión de control, dominio aislado de la infraestructura, el tecnologías específicas como piezas desechables: arquitectura evolutiva de verdad.
Testing como parte del entregable. Cobertura unitaria más tests de integración que levantan las piezas del caso de uso, con terceros simulados. Acá no hay QA: cada equipo prueba hasta donde el riesgo quede manejado.
Diagnóstico de performance e incidentes. Leer señales de la aplicación —observabilidad, trazas, métricas— y concluir qué dicen del software. La base de datos es un caso concreto: leer el plan de ejecución en vez de adivinarlo, índices, escaneos de tabla.
Tomar cualquier tarea técnica del producto, de punta a punta. React en el front de cara al cliente, .NET en el backend y Python en los servicios que ese backend consume. No entras a cubrir un hueco de tecnología: entras para que el squad pueda avanzar en los tres frentes a la vez, sin mayor acompañamiento.
Mandar a producción rápido para aprender del uso real. Valoramos llegar a tiempo al mercado, así que muchas decisiones se toman sabiendo que dejan deuda. Cada sprint reserva un espacio que planifica el propio equipo para robustecer lo que ya se validó como core: distinguir qué deuda se paga y cuál se deja viva es parte del rol.
Desarrollar con agentes y con contención. Vamos hacia un enfoque agéntico antes que de supervisión humana, y eso se sostiene con tests y restricciones alrededor de lo que hace el agente, no con fe.
Compartir el objetivo de negocio. El norte es el mismo para todo el squad: quienes vienen del lado de producto y quienes vienen del lado técnico persiguen el mismo resultado. Entiendes la tesis de negocio detrás de un requerimiento antes de implementarlo, y descartas rápido lo que no funciona.
Construir para el Maxxa que viene. Ya operamos en México y estamos evaluando el próximo país. El segmento al que apunta este producto —la empresa chica, la que nadie financia— es el mismo en toda la región, y lo que validemos acá es lo que se lleva.
Sostener el estándar sin autoridad formal. El producto se apoya en servicios que construyen otros equipos de Tecnología. No los diriges: los alineas, con criterio propio sobre qué aceptas recibir.
Cómo se ve que vas bien. Tomas tareas de complejidad creciente sin acompañamiento, los flujos que tocas quedan con su cobertura de tests y empiezas a proponer qué se robustece. Eso es lo que miramos, y se conversa contigo desde el primer día.
Haber construido en un producto en validación de mercado , no solo en líneas maduras y estables.
Haber aprendido un stack o tecnología nueva sobre la marcha y haber llegado a ser productivo rápido en ella.
Uso fluido de herramientas de IA para desarrollo (Claude Code, Cursor) con arnés propio: instrucciones de repo, skills, tests como límite del agente.
Formación en Ingeniería Civil en Computación / Informática, Industrial mención TI/Computación o afines. No es excluyente.
En Tecnología nos organizamos en squads de tres a cinco ingenieros con su product owner. La expectativa mutua es ser cada vez mejores ingenieros: hay referentes cercanos en casi todos los frentes, con harta disposición a compartir.

About Us:DeepJudge is Switzerland-s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible.

DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world-s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O-Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the role:As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DeepJudge, you own the technical implementation of our AI search platform for some of the world-s leading law firms.

Every customer environment is different: from cloud-native deployments to complex on-premise infrastructure, enterprise identity providers, document management systems, and datasets containing hundreds of millions of documents. Your mission is to ensure customers successfully deploy, integrate, and adopt DeepJudge in their environments.

This is a highly technical, customer-facing engineering role that sits at the intersection of software engineering, infrastructure, and enterprise AI.

You-ll spend your time deploying software, solving complex integration and infrastructure challenges, troubleshooting production issues during customer implementations, and working directly with engineering teams to continuously improve the product and deployment experience.

You-ll collaborate closely with Sales Engineering, Product, Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering to make every deployment faster, more reliable, and easier to operate. If you enjoy solving difficult technical problems, working directly with customers, and seeing the impact of your work in production, this role is for you.

No travel is required for this role. Your responsibilities will include: Owning the technical solution end to end, from architecture and hands-on implementation through production rollout and adoption, adapting DeepJudge to the customer-s environment and needs along the way.

Deploying and configuring DeepJudge across cloud and on-premise customer environments. Integrating DeepJudge with enterprise systems such as document management systems, identity providers, cloud platforms, and other data sources.

Troubleshooting complex issues across deployments, infrastructure, networking, authentication, integrations, and application behavior. Building deployment automation, implementation tooling, documentation, and operational playbooks that make customer deployments faster, easier, and more scalable.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering to solve complex technical challenges and improve both the product and deployment experience. Bringing recurring customer requirements and challenges back to the team and helping turn them into product and engineering improvements.

Taking ownership beyond your immediate projects: spotting what is missing, fixing what is broken, and helping us build the processes and tools we need as we scale. You-re a great fit if you: Have 3+ years of experience in Software Engineering, DevOps, Forward Deployment, Solutions Engineering, or a similar technical role.

Have experience deploying or operating enterprise software in production environments. Have experience with technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, Azure or GCP. Enjoy working directly with enterprise customers, building trusted technical relationships, and guiding complex implementation projects from kickoff to production.

Enjoy troubleshooting complex technical problems that span infrastructure, integrations, and application behavior. Can communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Bonus: Experience with enterprise search, AI/LLM platforms, document management systems, Infrastructure as Code, or experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment What you can look forward to: Owning the deployment of AI systems that power knowledge discovery for some of the world-s leading law firms.

Solving challenging engineering problems across enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, authentication systems, and large-scale data environments Working closely with experienced engineers, product teams, and customers to shape both our platform and how it is deployed A high-ownership engineering culture founded by ex-Google search engineers and ETH Zurich AI PhDs, where customer feedback directly influences the product The opportunity to improve deployment tooling, automation, and operational processes as we scale globally A collaborative team in Zurich shaping how AI transforms professional knowledge work.
